verdict.rationale: OpenRouter ships a first-party MCP server, so a user's AI assistant can be told in natural language to pull live OpenRouter data (models, prices, credits, rankings, docs) and send quick test messages. That is a real but narrow natural-language operating surface. There is also an official agent skill for migration tasks. The natural-language layer comes from the connected assistant, and the documented scope is mostly read-only data plus test messages. missing for 10: natural-language control of account operations such as key management, budgets and routing or privacy settings; a native in-product natural-language command interface; hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Once connected, your assistant can pull live OpenRouter data (models, prices, your credits, rankings, and docs) and send quick test messages, all without leaving your editor.
Install the migration skill to let your agent handle the import updates for you
